description: Synthetic technical fixture for the R4/R5 configurable-LLP compatibility layer (src/dvrecast/llp_event.py). NOT a physics benchmark, NOT physics-validated, and not tied to any specific 2HDM H2 interpretation. The PDG id 9000006 is Pythia's generic reserved 'other BSM particle' slot, reused here only as a stand-in scalar identity distinct from the strong-bm1 neutralino (1000022). Particle four-momenta are omitted (not needed by this smoke pipeline); 'charge' is a bookkeeping integer for exercising descendant counting, not a physically derived value.
